
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/tcjiaan/p/20875517" title="发布于 2026-06-28 19:07">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">【EF Core】级联删除行为</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>DeleteBehavior枚举（位于 Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore 命名空间）所定义的数据删除行为是争对存在相对关系的实体来说的。这个和数据库中表与表之间的关系一致。数据表之间是通过列引用实现的。假设 A 依赖 B，那么 A 中会存在一列或多列去引用 B 中的一列或多列（通常是主键）。在 A 中引用外部记录的列就成了外键。而删除行为描述的就是：当 B 被删除后，A 中的外键如何处理。</p>
<p>上面只是简单提一下数据库方面的知识，后面咱们会有例子。现在，咱们先看看&nbsp;DeleteBehavior 枚举定义了啥。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">enum</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> DeleteBehavior
{
    ClientNoAction,
    ClientSetNull,
    ClientCascade,
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">----------- 强力分割线 --------</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    
    Restrict,
    SetNull,
    Cascade,
    NoAction
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>如你所见，DeleteBehavior 枚举的成员可以分为两组。第一组是带 Client 开头的，就是客户端的意思。那客户端是谁？谁连接并操作数据库？是 EF Core，所以，它是客户端。因此，这一组的意思就是由 EF Core 来处理关系实体的级联删除行为。什么情况下会这样呢？先有数据库，然后根据数据库生成（编写）实体类，但数据库并未定义任何关系，由 EF Core 来管理关系。说大白话就是，数据库只建表和存储数据，并不定义其他对象。相信很多伙伴比较喜欢这种方案，老周可喜欢这样做了，数据库的作用只存数据，老周连存储过程都不写的。哪怕 SQL Server 有很多强大功能，老周只拿来建表，连视图都很少用。这样搞的好处是好维护，除非你那里有专人维护数据库，不然像老周这样，多数项目都是自己一手包办的，把很多数据库的处理逻辑搬到程序代码中，省了很多事。正因为经常这样，导致老周在写 SQL 方面比较菜。</p>
<p>现在有些 SQL 查询可以用 AI 生成，但你也别指望它是万能的，只是在赶时间的时候能省些功夫。一般查询的话 AI 是没啥问题，生成的语句也基本对的。除了这个，目前 AI 比较好用的就是在 CSS 上，其他（如 C++ 之属）除非是一些很“流行”或标准算法的代码，不然错误很多。有些代码甚至是全错的（说明没有训练过），毕竟模型再大也不可能应对实际应用。所以这玩意儿用来省省时间是可以的，全信它还不如信我是汉武帝。</p>
<p>曾有某新同事，就是懒得写一些初始化代码，就用 AI 帮他完成的初始化（C语言）。然后他很苦恼，因为他检查来检查去都没发现哪里错了，他经过多次生成代码问题依旧。烧录进单片机后无限 Reset。害得他装逼失败，被同事笑了两个星期（因为同事是女的，所以他要在她面前装逼，也是自作多情的小伙子）。最后他厚着脸皮来找老周。老周就帮他看了下代码，错误就在 memcpy 函数拷贝错了内存。估计这代码是从网上的多个源混合训练模型的，说不定是从谁的博文中偷的代码。不仅拷错了内存，还把别的内存破坏了。你会问：编译不报错？那肯定不报错了，语法上又没错。当然，这个你不能说是C语言的问题，C语言的强项就在这里，内存管理是直接的，而且权限都给了开发者的。好处是在性能的时候，你能做到极致。你有一把很锋利的宝刀，在高手看来那可是宝物，但是你练武的时候把自己的头砍了，那你不能怪这刀太锋利。</p>
<p>第二组就是不带 Client 开头的，自然是在数据库上定义外键约束。这个一般用在 Code First 方案，由 EF Core 生成 SQL 语句并创建数据库。当然，DB First 也可能的，比如你的表关系是数据库上定义的，而且也定义了外键约束。</p>
<p>老周写这一篇水文的目的就跟大伙伴说这个事，如何选择 DeleteBehavior 的值。</p>
<p>好，上面的内容比较无聊，相信大伙都看得天灵盖冒烟了。下面咱们搞些有趣的。这里以 SQL Server 数据库为例。为什么用它？因为方便，其他数据库没那么方便。所以一般老周写测试代码都会用 SQL Server。</p>
<p>建好数据库后，创建两个表。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">CREATE</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">TABLE</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">dbo</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span>.<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">tb_address</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (
    </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">Id</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span>       <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">INT</span>           <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 255, 1)">IDENTITY</span> (<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">1</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">1</span>) <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">NOT</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">city</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NVARCHAR</span> (<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">10</span>) <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">NOT</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">town</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NVARCHAR</span> (<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">20</span>) <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">NOT</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">zip_code</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">VARCHAR</span> (<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">8</span>)   <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
);

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">CREATE</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">TABLE</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">dbo</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span>.<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">tb_stu</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (
    </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">Id</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span>      <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">INT</span>           <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 255, 1)">IDENTITY</span> (<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">1</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">1</span>) <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">NOT</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">name</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span>    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NVARCHAR</span> (<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">12</span>) <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">NOT</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">age</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">INT</span>           <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">NOT</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">addr_id</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">INT</span>           <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span></span></strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
);</span></pre>
</div>
<p>很简单的两个表，一个表示地址，一个表示学生。字段也是随便写的，你不用在意是啥含义。不过，你要注意 tb_stu 表的 addr_id 字段。你能如老周一样聪明，肯定猜到了，它就是外键。是的，该字段就是引用 tb_address 表的主键的。但在数据库上没有配置外键和其他约束，</p>
<p>咱们在数据表中放一些数据，以供测试。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/367389/202606/367389-20260627181136440-1476079980.png" alt="image" width="301" height="96" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/367389/202606/367389-20260627181418097-324192827.png" alt="image" width="300" height="92" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>可以看到，这两个表是一对一的关系，即一名学生只对应一个地址。比如，范统同学的 addr_id 为 3，对应 Id=3 的地址，即他来自乌龟市王八镇。</p>
<p>咱们可以用联表查询来一览两个表的关系。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">select</span> s.<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">name</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span>, a.city, a.town <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> tb_stu s
</span><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">left</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">join</span></span></strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"> tb_address</span></strong> a
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">on</span> s.addr_id <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">=</span> a.Id;</pre>
</div>
<p>结果如下</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/367389/202606/367389-20260627182120491-643302736.png" alt="image" width="178" height="76" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>好了，数据准备好了，下面完成客户端代码。关于实体映射，你嫌麻烦可以用 EF 工具来生成。因为代码不多，老周直接手写了。</p>
<p>先定义实体类。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Student
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> Id { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> Name { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span>; } = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">default</span>!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> Age { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
    </span><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> Address? Addr { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span></span></strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">; }</span></strong>
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Address
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> Id { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> City { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span>; } = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">default</span>!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> Town { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span>; } = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">default</span>!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>? ZipCode { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>很 Easy，不用解释了啊。然后是从 DbContext 类派生出咱们自己的上下文（不派生也行，先初始化 Options 然后 new DbContext）。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">protected</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
{
    modelBuilder.Entity</span>&lt;Address&gt;(ent =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    {
        ent.ToTable(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tb_address</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        ent.Property(x </span>=&gt; x.Id).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        ent.Property(y </span>=&gt; y.City).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">city</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>).HasMaxLength(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">).IsUnicode();
        ent.Property(j </span>=&gt; j.ZipCode).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">zip_code</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>).HasMaxLength(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8</span>).IsUnicode(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        ent.Property(x </span>=&gt; x.Town).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">town</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>).HasMaxLength(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">20</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        ent.HasKey(x </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> x.Id);
    });
    modelBuilder.Entity</span>&lt;Student&gt;(ent =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    {
        ent.ToTable(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tb_stu</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        ent.Property(x </span>=&gt; x.Id).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        ent.Property(a </span>=&gt; a.Name).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">name</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>).HasMaxLength(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">12</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        ent.Property(s </span>=&gt; s.Age).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">age</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 影子属性</span>
        ent.Property&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>?&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">AddrId</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">addr_id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

        <strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">ent.HasOne(s </span></strong></span><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> s.Addr)
</span></span></strong>            <strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.WithOne()
</span></span></strong>            <strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.HasForeignKey</span>&lt;Student&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">AddrId</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span></span></strong>            <strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.HasPrincipalKey</span>&lt;Address&gt;(a =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> a.Id)
</span></span></strong>            <strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.ClientSetNull)
</span></span></strong>            <strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.IsRequired(</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span></span></strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">);</span></strong>
        ent.Navigation(s </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> s.Addr).<em><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 153, 1)">AutoInclude</span></em>();
    });
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>Student 实体的 Addr 属性是一个导航属性，引用 Address 实体实例。导航的含议就是从 Student 实体就能访问关系实体 Address。毕竟 EF Core 的核心思想是要面向对象的，肯定不能搞个外键来访问关系实体的。</p>
<p>配置的代码很简单，你可以不看，重点关注 HasOne 一段。</p>
<p>HasOne 表示从当前（Student）实体起，到 s.Addr 所导航的另一个实体（Address）的关系。啥关系？一个 Student 对一个 Address。</p>
<p>同理，随后 WithOne 的意思是从反向找关系，从 Address 到 Student 也是一个 Address 对着一个 Student 实体。由于 Address 实体中没有指向 Student 的导航属性，故 WithOne 方法不用传参。</p>
<p>因此，总结起来，Student -&gt; Address 是一对一关系。</p>
<p>HasForeignKey 方法配置外键，一对一的外键方法特殊，它可以指定一个类型参数，代表外键所在的实体。因为一对一比较特别，它既可以A引用B，也可以B引用A。所以，一对一关系必须交代明白谁引用谁，EF Core 无法自动识别。在本例中，是 Student 引用 Address，因此外键应当在 Student 实体上。但我们代码中基本不会去访问外键，所以老周把外键 AddrId 属性定义为影子属性——类中不定义的属性，只在 EF Core 的更改跟踪中维护。</p>
<p>调用 AutoInclude 方法的用途是让 EF Core 在查询 Student 实体时自动加载 Addr 导航属性，即引用相关的 Address 对象。这个会生成联表查询，就不用在LINQ语句中调用 Include 方法了。</p>
<p>现在，咱们做一件事： 把 Id 为 2 的 Address 记录删除。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>Address? theaddr = c.Set&lt;Address&gt;().FirstOrDefault(a =&gt; a.Id == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>(theaddr != <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 删除</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    c.Remove(theaddr);
}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 检测更改</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">c.ChangeTracker.<strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 153, 1)">DetectChanges</span></strong>();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 打印跟踪信息</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Console.WriteLine(c.ChangeTracker.ToDebugString());
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 提交更新</span>
c.SaveChanges();</pre>
</div>
<p>DetectChanges 是扫描实体并检测状态，这个在 SaveChanges 方法时也会调用。此处老周是为了打印实体状更新才这样做，实际使用时，不要调用 DetectChanges 方法。</p>
<p>运行一下，看看发生什么。</p>
<p>Address 是删除了，但 Student 中对应的外键没有设置为 NULL。这表明没达到咱们预期。</p>
<p>这是因为咱们只查询了 tb_address 表，EF Core 根本不知道 tb_stu 表中哪些行引用了 id=2 的地址信息，所以，EF Core 就无法进行级联处理。</p>
<p>修改为ID 为3的地址信息，它由 id=1 的学生记录引用。咱们要先查出 id=1 的 Student 记录，再通过 Addr 导航属性来获取对应的地址信息，然后删除。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>Student? student = c.Set&lt;Student&gt;().FirstOrDefault(s =&gt; s.Id == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>(student != <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null &amp;&amp; </span>student.Addr !=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)"> null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 删除</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">c.Remove(student.Addr);</span></strong>
}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 检测更改</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">c.ChangeTracker.DetectChanges();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 打印跟踪信息</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Console.WriteLine(c.ChangeTracker.ToDebugString());
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 提交更新</span>
c.SaveChanges();</pre>
</div>
<p>这一次结果正确。看看打印的实体状态变更。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>Address {Id: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">} Deleted
    Id: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> PK

<p>id=3 的地址信息被删除，而引用了此记录的 Student 对象，AddrId 也从原来的 3 变为 null。生成的 SQL 语句既有 DELETE 语句也有 UPDATE 语句。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">UPDATE</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">tb_stu</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">SET</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">addr_id</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">=</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">@p0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">DELETE</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">FROM</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">tb_address</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
      OUTPUT </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">1</span>
      <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">WHERE</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">Id</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">=</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">@p2</span>;</pre>
</div>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/367389/202606/367389-20260628105541715-2051719367.png" alt="image" width="339" height="96" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>如果把删除行为改为&nbsp;ClientCascade，那么，Address 记录删除后，引用该记录的 Student 记录也会被删除。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>ent.HasOne(s =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> s.Addr)
    .WithOne()
    .HasForeignKey</span>&lt;Student&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">AddrId</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    .HasPrincipalKey</span>&lt;Address&gt;(a =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> a.Id)
    .<strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.ClientCascade)</span></strong>
    .IsRequired(</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span>);</pre>
</div>
<p>运行代码会看到，除了被删的 Address 实体，引用它的 Student 实体也标记了删除。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>Address {Id: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">} Deleted
    Id: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> PK

<p>生成的SQL语句自然也会包含两条 DELETE FROM 语句。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">DELETE</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">FROM</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">tb_stu</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
      OUTPUT </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">1</span>
      <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">WHERE</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">Id</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">=</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">@p0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">DELETE</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">FROM</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">tb_address</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
      OUTPUT </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">1</span>
      <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">WHERE</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">Id</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">=</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">@p1</span>;</pre>
</div>
<p>剩下的&nbsp;ClientNoAction 行为就是当被引用的记录删除后，引用它的外键不会被删除，也不会设置为 NULL。就是啥也不做。这个就不演示了。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>DeleteBehavior 枚举的不带 Client 开头的成员表示级联删除行为会在数据库中定义。</p>
<p>1、Code First 方案下，创建数据库时，EF Core 会自动生成包含外键约束的 SQL 语句；</p>
<p>2 、DB First 方案下，数据库已定义了外键约束。删除时如果违反规范会报错。</p>
<p>总的来说就是数据库一定要定义外键约束且设置了级联删除行为（或保留默认值）。</p>
<p>下面的示例咱们采用 Code First 方案，由数据库执行级联删除。示例用的是 SQLite 数据库，要添加以下 nuget 库。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Sqlite</pre>
</div>
<p>定义两个实体类。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 暂时关闭 Nullable</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">#nullable disable

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> User
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> Uid { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> Name { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 导航属性
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">IEnumerable&lt;ShareItem&gt; Shares { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span></span></strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">; }</span></strong>
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ShareItem
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> ShareID { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> Title { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> FileName { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>? Comment { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 恢复 Nullable</span>
#nullable enable</pre>
</div>
<p>User 实体代表用户信息，ShareItem 代表用户分享的文件信息。User.Shares 是导航属性，即一个用户可以分享多个文件，所以，用户与分享文件信息之间是一对多的关系。</p>
<p>下面是配置模型，这里老周演示一下如何不继承 DbContext 来配置。</p>
<p>1、先创建&nbsp;ModelBuilder 实例。这里注意，咱们不用直接调用构造函数，那样约定集合是空的，就无法使用 EF Core 内置的约定功能了，很多东西就要手动配置了。所以要用 SqliteConventionSetBuilder.CreateModelBuilder 静态方法。每个数据库都会提供这个方法的，比如&nbsp;SqlServerConventionSetBuilder。这些类能够创建包含内置约定的 ModelBuilder。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>ModelBuilder modelBuilder = SqliteConventionSetBuilder.CreateModelBuilder();</pre>
</div>
<p>有了 ModelBuilder 实例，剩下的事情你应该全懂了，一样的配方，熟悉的家乡味。</p>
<p>2、配置数据库模型——添加实体。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 添加实体</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> entUser = modelBuilder.Entity&lt;User&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> entShareItem = modelBuilder.Entity&lt;ShareItem&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 配置主键</span>
entUser.HasKey(u =&gt; u.Uid).HasName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">PK_UserID</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
entShareItem.HasKey(s </span>=&gt; s.ShareID).HasName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">PK_ShareID</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 外键存在于 ShareItem 中，用影子属性来存储</span>
entShareItem.Property&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>?&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">userId</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 表映射</span>
entUser.ToTable(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tb_users</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, tb =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
{
    tb.Property(u </span>=&gt; u.Uid).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">u_id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    tb.Property(u </span>=&gt; u.Name).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">u_name</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
});
entShareItem.ToTable(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tb_shares</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, tb =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
{
    tb.Property(s </span>=&gt; s.ShareID).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">sh_id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    tb.Property(s </span>=&gt; s.Title).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">sh_title</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    tb.Property(s </span>=&gt; s.FileName).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">sh_file</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    tb.Property(s </span>=&gt; s.Comment).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">sh_cmt</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 这个是影子属性映射的</span>
    tb.Property(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">userId</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">usr_id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
});
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 一对多关系</span>
entUser.HasMany(u =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> u.Shares)
        .WithOne()
        .HasForeignKey(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">userId</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        .HasPrincipalKey(u </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> u.Uid)
        .<strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade)</span></strong>
        .HasConstraintName(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">FK_ShareToUser</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>);</pre>
</div>
<p>由于是一对多关系，所以外键只能放在 ShareItem 实体上，调用 HasForeignKey 方法不必考虑类型参数了（人家也没声明类型参数）。OnDelete设置为级联删除。也就是：如果某个 User 对象被删了，那么，与它有关的 ShareItem 对象也要一起删除（株连三族）。</p>
<p>3、创建&nbsp;DbContextOptionsBuilder 实例，用来配置 DbContext，如数据库连接字符串等。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 准备调料（选项）</span>
DbContextOptionsBuilder opbuilder = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> DbContextOptionsBuilder();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 使用啥数据库</span>
opbuilder.<em><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">UseSqlite(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">data source=shareMan.db</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span></span></em><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><em><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">)</span></em>;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 需要日志</span>
opbuilder.LogTo(msg =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
{
    Console.ForegroundColor </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ConsoleColor.Green;
    Console.WriteLine(msg);
    Console.ResetColor();
},
(eventid, _) </span>=&gt; eventid == RelationalEventId.CommandExecuted);</pre>
</div>
<p>LogTo 调用的重载有两个委托。第一个是输入一个 string 参数，这个参数是日志内容，可以自定义记录方式。比如写到文件中，这里老周只写到控制台。第二个委托有两个输入参数：参数A是日志关联的 EventId，参数B是日志等级（调试、严重、警告、信息），返回值是 bool 类型，这个委托是个筛选器，返回 true 表示记录它；返回 false 表示不记录该条日志。这里只判断事件&nbsp;RelationalEventId.CommandExecuted，如果是它就记录，其他事件拜拜。CommandExecuted 指的是执行 SQL 之后发生。这个配置的目的就是记录 SQL 语句。</p>
<p>4、很重要一步，新手最容易忘记。因为咱们现在不继承 DbContext 类，就不会重写 OnModelCreating 方法了，所以，你得让 DbContext 知道咱们用的数据库模型。所以要调用 UseModel 方法关联我们前面配置好的模型。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>opbuilder.UseModel(modelBuilder.Model.FinalizeModel());</pre>
</div>
<p>调用 FinalizeModel 方法是让模型固定（只读，不能改了）。</p>
<p>5、实例化DbContext对象，把选项传进构造函数。其他操作不变。</p>
<p>6、先动态创建一下数据库，存入些测试数据。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> (DbContext ctx = <strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1); background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">new</span></strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">(opbuilder.Options)</span></strong>)
 {
     </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">bool</span> done =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ctx.Database.EnsureCreated();
     </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(done)
     {
         User u1 </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">()
         {
             Name </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">吴淼水</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
             Shares </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> [
                 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ShareItem{
                     Title </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">大宋神探</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                     FileName </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">神碳吴四水.docx</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                     Comment </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">时代楷模</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
                 }
             ]
         };

         User u2 </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">()
         {
             Name </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">高大上</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
             Shares </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> List&lt;ShareItem&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
                     </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ShareItem
                     {
                         Title </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">想要飞得更高</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                         FileName </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">励志王.pdf</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                         Comment </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">笑死人</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
                     },
                     </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ShareItem
                     {
                         Title </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">一氧化二氢居然有毒</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                         FileName </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">2026智慧档案.doc</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                         Comment </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">民用化学开山之祖</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
                     }
             }
         };

         </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 将两实体标记为 Added 状态</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">         ctx.AddRange(u1, u2);
         </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 保存数据</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">         ctx.SaveChanges();
         Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\n---------- 初始化后 ----------</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
         PrintUsers(ctx.Set</span>&lt;User&gt;().Include(u =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> u.Shares).ToArray());
     }
 }</span></pre>
</div>
<p>访问&nbsp;DbContextOptionsBuilder 对象的 Options 属性，你就能拿到已配置的选项了。</p>
<p>PrintUsers 是个自定义方法，用来打印 User 与跟它有关的 ShareItem 信息。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> PrintUsers(IEnumerable&lt;User&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> usrs)
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">foreach</span>(User u <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> usrs)
    {
        Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">用户：{u.Name} ({u.Uid})</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 遍历导航属性</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">foreach</span>(ShareItem share <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> u.Shares)
        {
            Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\t{share.Title} | {share.FileName}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        }
    }
    Console.WriteLine();
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>创建数据表的 SQL 如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>CREATE TABLE <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tb_users</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (
          </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">u_id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> INTEGER NOT NULL CONSTRAINT <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">PK_UserID</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
          </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">u_name</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TEXT NULL
      );

CREATE TABLE </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tb_shares</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (
          </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">sh_id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> INTEGER NOT NULL CONSTRAINT <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">PK_ShareID</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
          </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">sh_title</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TEXT NULL,
          </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">sh_file</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TEXT NULL,
          </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">sh_cmt</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TEXT NULL,
          </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">usr_id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> INTEGER NULL,
          CONSTRAINT </span><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">FK_ShareToUser</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> FOREIGN KEY (<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">usr_id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>) REFERENCES <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tb_users</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> (<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">u_id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span></span></strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">) ON DELETE CASCADE</span></strong>
      );</span></pre>
</div>
<p>数据库中在 tb_shares 表中已定义了外键约束，且级联删除。</p>
<p>8、我们现在删除一个用户。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> (DbContext ctx = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(opbuilder.Options))
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 找出吴四水</span>
    User? theuser = ctx.Set&lt;User&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">()
        .Include(u </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> u.Shares)
        .FirstOrDefault(u </span>=&gt; u.Name.Equals(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">吴淼水</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">));
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>(theuser != <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 把它删除</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        ctx.Remove(theuser);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 保存</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        ctx.SaveChanges();

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 删除后</span>
        Console.WriteLine(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\n---------- 删除用户后 ----------</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        PrintUsers(ctx.Set</span>&lt;User&gt;().Include(u =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> u.Shares).ToArray());
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>Include 方法就是连同关系表一起查询。由于数据量小，咱们不用考虑笛卡尔乘积问题，所以就不必分开查询了。</p>
<p>生成的SQL如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">DELETE</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">FROM</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> "tb_shares"
      </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">WHERE</span> "sh_id" <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">=</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">@p0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
      RETURNING </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">DELETE</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">FROM</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> "tb_users"
      </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">WHERE</span> "u_id" <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">=</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">@p0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
      RETURNING </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">1</span>;</pre>
</div>
<p>对比一下，删除前后打印的数据。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>---------- 初始化后 ----------<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
用户：吴淼水 (</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        大宋神探 | 神碳吴四水.docx
用户：高大上 (</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        想要飞得更高 | 励志王.pdf
        一氧化二氢居然有毒 | 2026智慧档案.doc

</span>---------- 删除用户后 ----------<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
用户：高大上 (</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        想要飞得更高 | 励志王.pdf
        一氧化二氢居然有毒 | 2026智慧档案.doc</span></pre>
</div>
<p>哈哈，这个对比其实没B用，反正 User 已经没了一个，自然查不到 ShareItem 了。</p>
<p>好了，今天咱们就水到这里了。</p>
